distance_definition: Number of agent/user turns after the causal clue and before fast-forward; includes the evaluated pre-gap action and user acknowledgement.
clue: The replacement plan is active, but the pharmacy profile still shows my previous plan.
clue_answer: the pharmacy profile still used the previous plan
clue_ablation_text: I am not sure; I do not have the account-history detail available.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hi, I am calling to refill my blood pressure prescription.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Can I get your date of birth to open the profile?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It is March twelfth, nineteen seventy-one.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The claim is approved only when the pharmacy billing profile matches the currently active plan; otherwise it is rejected.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Understood; I checked which plan the profile uses.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Would you like a text when the order is ready?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, a text is fine.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is Doctor Patel still the prescriber?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, Doctor Patel is still my doctor.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you need any other prescriptions refilled?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No, just this one.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is the phone number ending in four-two-two-one current?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, that is still my number.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Are there any new allergies to record?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No new allergies.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is the generic version acceptable?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, generic is fine.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is the pickup location on Main Street still convenient?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, I am nearby.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Does the pharmacy billing profile match the plan that is active now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The replacement plan is active, but the pharmacy profile still shows my previous plan.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Would you like pickup or delivery?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Pickup is fine.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Has the dosage changed recently?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No, it is the same ten milligram dose.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Submit the order to the automated claim process.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I will wait while you handle that.

user_action.observation: While you were unavailable, I corrected the pharmacy billing profile so it uses the active plan.

claim_status.not_submitted: the claim has not entered the processor
claim_status.processing: the claim is currently being processed
claim_status.rejected: the processor denied the submitted claim

causal_alignment.misaligned: the pharmacy bills an outdated plan rather than the active plan
causal_alignment.aligned: the pharmacy billing profile matches the active plan

pre_gap_actions.description: Submit the order to the automated claim process.
Pause and contact the prescriber for a new order.
Bypass the normal transaction and offer another payment route.
Close the request without sending the order.

post_gap_actions.description: Review the account information used by the automated transaction before retrying.
Send the same transaction through the automated process now.
Ask the prescriber to issue a replacement order.
Wait another interval for the existing transaction.
Conclude that the completed operation succeeded, then close the request.

causal_post_gap_observation.text: Twenty minutes have passed and processing finished, but the result code is not visible. Based on the plan detail I gave earlier, what is the next step?

response_styles.description: Briefly acknowledge the user's frustration or experienced impact before proceeding.
Acknowledge the time pressure and prioritize the immediate next step.
Briefly clarify the situation and reassure the user before proceeding.
Proceed directly and neutrally to the next operational step.

questions.question: Does the pharmacy billing profile match the plan that is active now?
questions.gold_answer: the pharmacy profile still used the previous plan

tag_definitions.EARLY_CLUE_LOSS: The selected action is attractive when the early clue is unavailable or unused.
tag_definitions.STATE_SYNC_FAILURE: The action treats the pre-gap world as if it still held after time advanced.
tag_definitions.TIME_INFERENCE_FAILURE: The action fails to use elapsed time when interpreting the observation.
tag_definitions.REPEATED_ACTION: The action repeats a step already attempted without a new justification.
tag_definitions.PREMATURE_CLOSE: The action closes an interaction whose state is unresolved.
tag_definitions.PREMATURE_ESCALATION: The action escalates before supported diagnostic or policy steps are exhausted.
tag_definitions.ACTION_SELECTION_FAILURE: The action is inconsistent with the current state but has no narrower failure label.
tag_definitions.PROSODY_GROUNDING_FAILURE: The response approach does not match the audible delivery.
tag_definitions.BELIEF_REPORT_INVALID: One or more required state-belief distributions or revalidation flags are missing or malformed.
tag_definitions.STATE_BELIEF_ERROR: At least one required checkpoint assigns its highest probability to the wrong hidden state.
